people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: And many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem and to plead before the LORD.”
translations.kjv: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
translations.asv: Yea, many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek Jehovah of hosts in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favor of Jehovah.
